name: mutation-coordinator
body: The session-scoped mutation coordinator process: a short-lived `apg session start` … `apg session end` service that owns the worktree `db.lbug` as sole writer and exposes a Unix socket at `<apg_root>/.trans/session.sock` — with a deterministic `/tmp/apg-session-<hash>.sock` fallback when the platform socket-path length limit is exceeded, the same path for the server and every client and cleaned up on end/reclaim — for routed mutations and read-through queries. It amortizes one DB open/parse across the session and applies each routed mutation's exact projection delta synchronously through its write-through projection component — visibility is never deferred to session end. C4 container of the apg CLI system. Realized by `apg.session`, `apg.session.Coordinator`, `.serve`, and `.handle_mutation`.
